head: Samsung Galaxy Watch 2027: no new model, a report says
dek: Samsung won't release a new Galaxy Watch in 2027 and will move to a new model every other year, according to Korea's ETNews; the next one would come in 2028. Samsung hasn't confirmed it.
details: Samsung has released a new Galaxy Watch every year since 2018; the 2027 model would likely have been called the Galaxy Watch 10. The report links the change to a push for profit after two quarters of losses in Samsung's mobile division and to Galaxy Watch 9 sales below expectations. Samsung plans software updates and more health features for its watches in 2027, and a Galaxy Fit 4 tracker is expected that year.
where: Report only; Samsung hasn't announced its plans
means: If you were waiting for next year's model, the current Galaxy Watch may stay the newest one until 2028, with updates instead.
todo: Nothing to do yet; if you need a watch now, there's no sign of a 2027 model to wait for.
